text:
Just published the design studio improvements branch to the live site.

It is a small update, but shipping code safely is always the goal. Even routine frontend changes need a clear line of sight from the repository to production. When auditors ask how changes move into live environments, having a direct record of the commit and branch saves you from digging through release logs.

Pushed the code, verified the live site, and moved on. Simple change management in practice.

#ITOps #GRC
